name: [BACKFILL] Client Leads sheets → Supabase · lead dates

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: apply=false is a dry run: the SQL plans every move and writes nothing. Flip to true for the real run, then flip back and re-export.

parameters.query:
with p as (
  select $1::uuid as client_id, $2::text::jsonb as j, $3::text::boolean as apply, $4::text as client, $5::text as date_order
),
raw as (
  select lower(btrim(coalesce(r->>'email','')))                                        as k_email,
         lower(regexp_replace(btrim(coalesce(r->>'full_name','')), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))   as k_full,
         -- First comma-separated segment only. An Aimfox sheet row joins EVERY current employer with
         -- commas while leads.company_name keeps the first, so comparing the whole string never
         -- matches and the 19 Aimfox leads this workflow exists to re-date were invisible to it.
         lower(regexp_replace(btrim(split_part(coalesce(r->>'company',''), ',', 1)),   '\s+', ' ', 'g'))   as k_company,
         (nullif(r->>'lead_received',''))::date                                        as lead_received
  from p, jsonb_array_elements(p.j) r
),
sheet as (
  select k_email, k_full, k_company, min(lead_received) as lead_received, count(*) as sheet_rows
  from raw
  where lead_received is not null and (k_email <> '' or k_full <> '')
  group by k_email, k_full, k_company
),
leads_n as (
  select l.id, l.origin_reply_id, l.created_at, l.sequencer_id,
         lower(btrim(coalesce(l.email,'')))                                            as k_email,
         lower(regexp_replace(btrim(coalesce(l.first_name,'') || ' ' || coalesce(l.last_name,'')), '\s+', ' ', 'g')) as k_full,
         lower(regexp_replace(btrim(split_part(coalesce(l.company_name,''), ',', 1)), '\s+', ' ', 'g'))    as k_company
  from p join public.leads l on l.client_id = p.client_id
),
matched as (
  select s.k_full, s.sheet_rows, s.lead_received,
         n.id as lead_id, n.origin_reply_id, n.created_at, n.sequencer_id,
         count(*) over (partition by s.k_email, s.k_full, s.k_company) as leads_for_row,
         count(*) over (partition by n.id)                             as rows_for_lead
  from sheet s
  join leads_n n
    on (s.k_email <> '' and n.k_email = s.k_email)
    or (s.k_full  <> '' and n.k_full  = s.k_full and n.k_company = s.k_company)
),
plan as (
  select lead_id, origin_reply_id, sequencer_id, created_at, lead_received, k_full
  from matched
  where sheet_rows = 1 and leads_for_row = 1 and rows_for_lead = 1
    and created_at::date is distinct from lead_received
),
upd_replies as (
  update public.replies r
     set received_at = pl.lead_received::timestamptz
    from plan pl, p
   where p.apply and r.id = pl.origin_reply_id
  returning r.id
),
upd_leads as (
  update public.leads l
     set created_at = pl.lead_received::timestamptz, updated_at = now()
    from plan pl, p
   where p.apply and l.id = pl.lead_id
  returning l.id
)
select (select client_id from p)                                                       as client_id,
       (select client    from p)                                                       as client,
       (select date_order from p)                                                      as date_order,
       (select apply     from p)                                                       as applied,
       (select count(*)  from raw)                                                     as sheet_rows,
       (select count(*)  from raw where lead_received is null)                         as sheet_rows_no_date,
       (select count(distinct lead_id) from matched)                                   as matched_leads,
       (select count(distinct lead_id) from matched
         where sheet_rows > 1 or leads_for_row > 1 or rows_for_lead > 1)                as ambiguous_leads,
       (select count(*) from plan)                                                     as to_move,
       (select count(*) from plan where sequencer_id = '00000000-0000-4000-a000-000000000003') as to_move_aimfox,
       (select count(*) from plan where origin_reply_id is not null)                    as to_move_with_reply,
       (select count(*) from upd_leads)                                                 as leads_moved,
       (select count(*) from upd_replies)                                               as replies_moved,
       (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x->>'from'), '[]'::jsonb) from (
          select jsonb_build_object('lead', k_full, 'from', created_at::date::text,
                                    'to', lead_received::text) as x
          from plan limit 25) s)                                                        as sample;

select c.id::text as client_id, c.name
from public.clients c
join public.client_sequencers cs on cs.client_id = c.id
join public.sequencers s on s.id = cs.sequencer_id and s.key = 'emailbison'
where cs.external_workspace_id = $1
limit 1;
